decisions.reason: After several years the bleaching tray blanks still fit the firm's dental materials and thermoforming knowledge base, so accumulated learning and existing channels make continued refinement more attractive than withdrawal.

The PETG thermoforming blank is highly aligned with the firm's established materials, production, and quality capabilities, giving management strong absorptive capacity to improve and commercialise it further.
The custom earmold line builds directly on the firm's long-standing hearing-care custom manufacturing expertise and customer relationships, so it remains a core product to retain and optimise.

Custom hearing protection earmolds are still closely related to the firm's earmold know-how and specialist channels, but their somewhat more adjacent application keeps exit risk modestly higher than for the core earmold line.
